name: Focusmaxxing
subtitle: The two custom apps and the hub that keeps them working.
description: Focusmaxxing Hub installs Custom blocked Instagram and Custom blocked YouTube, renews them in the background, and holds the switches that block the distracting parts of each app.

apps.name: Focusmaxxing Hub
apps.subtitle: Keeps your custom apps working.
apps.localizedDescription: Focusmaxxing Hub keeps Custom blocked Instagram and YouTube installed and holds their switches. The cloud build updates this entry on every build.

privacy.name: LocalNetwork
privacy.usageDescription: Focusmaxxing Hub can use local network access to find devices on your network. This is not needed for normal use.

privacy.name: NSBackgroundAudioUsageDescription
privacy.usageDescription: Lets Focusmaxxing Hub keep working for more than 30 seconds while it renews apps in the background.

privacy.name: NSBackgroundFetchUsageDescription
privacy.usageDescription: Focusmaxxing Hub renews your apps in the background so they keep opening.

apps.name: Custom blocked Instagram
apps.subtitle: Instagram with the feed, reels, stories, suggestions, messages, notifications and comments switchable.
apps.localizedDescription: The real Instagram with focusmaxxing inside. Everything starts blocked. Open Focusmaxxing Hub to change a switch; changes apply the next time Instagram is opened.

apps.name: Custom blocked YouTube
apps.subtitle: YouTube with recommendations, comments, notifications, Shorts scrolling and ads switchable.
apps.localizedDescription: The real YouTube with focusmaxxing inside, signed in with your Google account. Everything starts blocked. Open Focusmaxxing Hub to change a switch; changes apply the next time YouTube is opened.
